name: MR CLEAN
fullName: A Randomized Trial of Intraarterial Treatment for Acute Ischemic Stroke
population: n=500, mean 65 (range 23-96), NIHSS moderate-severe (proximal occlusion), ≤6 h
finding: Favored EVT; mRS 0-2: 32.6% vs 19.1% (absolute difference 13.5 pp, 95% CI 5.9-21.2)
teachingPoint: Established EVT within 6 h for proximal anterior-circulation LVO as effective and safe on top of IV thrombolysis.

name: ESCAPE
fullName: Randomized Assessment of Rapid Endovascular Treatment of Ischemic Stroke
population: n=316, adults, NIHSS disabling deficit (proximal occlusion), ≤12 h
finding: Favored EVT; mRS 0-2: 53.0% vs 29.3% (p<0.001). Stopped early for efficacy
teachingPoint: Confirmed EVT benefit with imaging-selected small core and good collaterals up to 12 h, with reduced mortality.

name: EXTEND-IA
fullName: Endovascular Therapy for Ischemic Stroke with Perfusion-Imaging Selection
population: n=70, adults, Alteplase <4.5 h; EVT started at median 210 min
finding: Both favored EVT: reperfusion median 100% vs 37% (p<0.001); early improvement 80% vs 37% (p=0.002). Stopped early for efficacy
teachingPoint: Showed perfusion-selected patients gain large reperfusion and functional benefits from stent-retriever EVT added to alteplase.

name: SWIFT PRIME
fullName: Stent-Retriever Thrombectomy after Intravenous t-PA vs. t-PA Alone in Stroke
finding: Favored EVT (p<0.001); mRS 0-2: 60% vs 35% (p<0.001). Stopped early for efficacy
teachingPoint: Confirmed stent-retriever EVT within 6 h on top of IV t-PA markedly increases functional independence.

name: REVASCAT
fullName: Thrombectomy within 8 Hours after Symptom Onset in Ischemic Stroke
finding: Favored EVT; mRS 0-2: 43.7% vs 28.2% (adjusted OR 2.1, 95% CI 1.1-4.0)
teachingPoint: Extended the randomized EVT evidence to 8 h and to a registry-embedded, population-representative setting.

name: HERMES
fullName: Endovascular Thrombectomy after Large-Vessel Ischaemic Stroke: Meta-analysis of Individual Patient Data from Five Randomised Trials
population: n=1287, all ages (incl. ≥80), NIHSS all enrolled, randomized ≤12 h
finding: Strongly favored EVT; NNT 2.6 to reduce disability by ≥1 mRS level
teachingPoint: Cemented EVT as standard of care for proximal anterior-circulation LVO, irrespective of patient characteristics.
